David Sutman, Jr.

Independent candidate for United States Senate, Tennessee · Challenger

Businessperson (says his background is in business and technology)

David Sutman Jr. is running as an independent for U.S. Senate in Tennessee. He calls himself a working-class Tennessean and political outsider who has never held public office. He is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot against incumbent Republican Bill Hagerty, Democrat Marquita Bradshaw, and several other independent candidates.

Where Jr. stands

Wages / economy
Says rising grocery, housing and fuel costs are hurting working families. Says he will focus on practical ways to lower everyday costs, support small businesses and expand economic opportunity.
National debt / fiscal policy
Says Washington spends without accountability. Supports cutting wasteful spending and making federal spending more transparent.
Government accountability
Supports term limits and more transparency in government spending. Says elected officials should be held to real performance standards.
Constitution / democracy
Says he supports constitutional rights, balanced governance and respect for the rule of law. Says he will protect individual freedoms and vote based on what helps his constituents rather than party leadership.
